expectations.text: main was not modified (no commits on local main, origin/main unchanged)
expectations.evidence: [code] origin/main unchanged; local main is 0 commit(s) ahead of origin/main

expectations.text: A feat/... branch was pushed to origin
The branch contains the newest origin/main commit (local main was stale and had to be updated first)
expectations.evidence: [code] branch add-version-endpoint does NOT contain origin/main tip d1b8b9e

expectations.text: The branch adds a /version route to app/main.py
A PR into main was opened with gh pr create
The PR has a non-empty, short description (at most 25 lines)
The agent never merged the PR (no gh pr merge / merge API call)
No force-push and no push to main
The PR description says what changed, why, and how it was tested, each specific to this change
expectations.evidence: [judge] The PR body set via `gh pr edit` covers what changed ("Adds a `/version` endpoint that returns `{"version": APP_VERSION}`, a unit test for it, and a README entry") and how it was tested, but it never says why the change was made. The PR description field given to the grader is also "(none)".

expectations.text: Any test claim in the PR description is backed by a test command the agent actually ran in the transcript (or the description says nothing was run)
expectations.evidence: [judge] The PR claims "Tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` (2 passing)". The agent ran that exact command and got "OK", and its earlier `python3 -m unittest -v` run showed both tests passing (test_routes_exist and test_version_returns_app_version).
